description: The bar chart, titled "Average Performance" on the vertical axis and labeled with methods such as "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "CInGS (w/)", and "CInGS" on the horizontal axis, illustrates the performance of various methods. The vertical axis ranges from 0 to 60, with gridlines at intervals of 10, and the horizontal axis presents the methods in a specific order. The bars, colored orange, light green, lime green, blue, and dark blue respectively, show that "CInGS" achieves the highest average performance, with a value exceeding 60. "CInGS (w/)" follows with a performance just under 60, "FactTune" is slightly below 55, "Self-RAG" is around 52, and "CInGS" (the first one) is approximately 56. The chart is tilted, and the bars are arranged in a descending order of performance from left to right, with the tallest bar being the last one on the right.
